### Historical audit — S0198

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_155212263/trajectory.jsonl`. Offsets below are character ranges in the supplied JSONL observations.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 1 [0,5609) | The assigned goal was to reconstruct an indoor photograph as separate Blender/SceneAct meshes, matching geometry, materials, viewpoint and framing. This is the requested goal, not evidence of the photograph’s contents or a completed reconstruction. The reference image itself is not visible in the supplied observation. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2 [0,2611) | A fresh, read-only Codex session was launched with the image staged as input. It failed with exit code 1 after about 13.9 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls and an unknown actual model. No autonomous exploration is visible. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3 [0,538); `scene_error`, line 4 [0,1601) | The runtime reported the failed student exit while requesting a response. A stderr path is named, but its contents are not supplied; the underlying cause is therefore unknown. |

**Changes and validation.** No student program, scene build, mesh change, render, review, or final `DONE` is visible. Thus there is no evidence to assess multiple objects, materials or textures, part connections, pose, camera, lighting, or rendering quality. The prompt requires several of these, but requirements are not results. No formal scene score or geometric validation is shown.

**Teacher input.** No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or execution appears, and there is no evidence of student receipt or adoption.

**Outcome and lessons.** This is a **technical interruption** before a visible solution, not evidence of an algorithmic failure or an empty submitted patch. The transferable operational lesson is that a failed model invocation can prevent even an initial build; the task-specific cause and any reconstruction defects remain unresolved hypotheses. The trace does not establish what appeared in the reference image, why the invocation failed, or whether anything happened outside these recorded events.
